summary: A six-voice analog-style polysynth that runs the AMY synthesizer library and plays its emulations of the Roland Juno-60's 128 factory patches, editable from the four knobs or the AMYboard web editor. Experimental.
features: 128 Juno-60 factory patches, chosen with the PRESETS knob
Eleven knob pages: oscillators, LFO, filter, envelopes, EQ, chorus, reverb, distortion
Class-compliant USB MIDI on channel 1 with velocity, bend and sustain
Live editing from the AMYboard editor over MIDI SysEx
Nothing is saved; no echo, no DX7 patches, keys not sent to MIDI

headings: fm1-amy: a juno-60 synth for the m-vave fm-1
